answer: Rewards vest linearly over 3 epochs and stop vesting the moment the identity is slashed, so an operator that gets caught forfeits the unvested remainder rather than just the current payment. Because the vertex ledger tracks the vesting curve, the ferrous audit publishes how much each key actually received. Running aliases in rotation therefore never collects the full amount on any of them, because each one needs to survive the whole ripple schedule. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
